form.keyLocked: Cannot be changed - saved vehicles point at this code.
form.keyHelp: Lowercase, no accents. This is what gets saved on vehicles and appears in filter links.
form.keyPattern: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore only
form.label: Display name
form.descriptionHelp: Shown in small print under the name in pickers and filters. Optional.
form.iconUrlHelp: Small transparent image shown on pickers and filters (PNG or WebP). Leave empty to show text only.
form.activeHelp: Disabling hides it from the vehicle form and filters; existing vehicles still show the right name.
form.vehicleTypesHelp: Leave empty for all vehicle types. Pick some to show this entry only where it makes sense.
form.homeSectionHelp: The home page card uses the display name above and follows this catalog's order; tapping it opens the car list filtered by this body type.
form.showOnHomeHelp: When on, this body type gets a card in the home page "Vehicle types" section. A home image is required.
form.showcaseImageHelp: A cut-out car photo (PNG or WebP with transparent background), landscape around 16:9, at least 960px wide.
form.showcaseImageRequired: Upload a home image to show this body type on the home page
form.showcaseExamplesHelp: A few typical models, shown small under the name on the home card. Optional.
form.labelEnHelp: Shown when customers browse in English. Leave empty to use the display name above - fine for proper names such as brands.
